mu_name_from: MuMain loads glove indexes 10 to 14 from GloveElf{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp line 151: `AccessModel(MODEL_GLOVES + i + 10, ..., L"GloveElf", i + 1)`), so index 13 is GloveElf04, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Spirit Gloves. mu.db agrees: code 5133, group 10 index 13, Player/GloveElf04.bmd.
why_this_one: The Fairy Elf's fourth set and the first of her two that are plate: Eo the Craftsman sells all five pieces at +3 on the first row of his shelf (src/sim/market.cpp, kCraftsman), so Noria's second merchant had a shelf whose top half could not be looked at. Spirit is the Brass set's metal in the elf's green: the same 10-series sheets MU recoloured with a `c`.
profile_from: armour, not soft_armour. Vine, Silk and Wind are hide and cloth and took soft_armour; Spirit is plate. Its sheets are the Brass set's 10-series in the elf's green - upper_10c and lower_10c are upper_10_m and lower_10_m repainted, and the Brass set is plate_steel with brass ornaments - so the default plate_steel is what most of it is, and the `c` recolour changes the paint and not how the thing was made.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs line 117. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateGloves(number, name, dropLevel, defense, attackSpeed, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). Slot 5, so `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)` makes the group 10.
stats.attack_speed_note: Recorded and unread: the sim takes attack speed off the weapon row alone.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 0, 1 - the Fairy Elf alone. Eighty agility beside forty strength is the row saying the same thing in stats.

sheet_from: Data/Player/gloves_10c.OZJ (64x64), hide.jpg and lower_09c.OZT (32x32), from MuMain. The .bmd names gloves_10c.jpg, hide.jpg and lower_09c.tga; 80 of the 144 triangles are on the first, 6 on hide and 58 on lower_09c.
sheet_note: gloves_10c is the Brass Gloves' gloves_10 in the elf's green, a dark green vambrace with a gold-ribbed cuff, drawn from two sides. Mean (37, 58, 49) at chroma 34. lower_09c is the curled green-and-gold fin whose alpha cuts 53% away, and here it carries 58 triangles, far more than the four quads the armour and boots give it: 54 of them are welded into the gauntlet as its flared cuff, and 4 are fins on crossed quads at the wrist. hide is MU capping the openings.
material_note: Four islands. Islands 0 and 1 are 70 each: gloves_10c's 40, lower_09c's 27 and hide's 3 per hand, welded into one shell - so 54 of lower_09c's 58 triangles are not a free ornament here but the flared green cuff built into the gauntlet. plate_steel, by the island rule and by the majority, and the cuff is hard green-and-gold paint that reads as plate anyway. Islands 2 and 3 are two triangles each, lower_09c's other 4: the fins on crossed quads at each wrist, where the Brass Gloves carry their gold fans, and they take brass as those do. The green is dark - lower_10c averages lum about 60 - and a dark albedo at metallic 1.0 is the shape of the Bone set's fault, so it was weighed: here it is plate, as the Bronze-green Scale set's verdigris plate is (HelmMale07's note), and the gold ribbing is what the metal's highlight has to catch.
